CustomField.description: Which signing provider to use. Only the exact word DocuSign reaches Modon's live DocuSign account; anything else, including blank, uses the stub that never leaves the org. Written this way round on purpose: reaching the real account has to be a deliberate act, not an oversight. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Signing Provider
